log-rollover.why: append-log.mjs: when the latest part of today reaches part-kb (90 KB), the next append starts the next part (first line '# Log <date> — part N (continues part N-1)') and closes the previous one with '→ continued in log/<date>.N.md'. check-hygiene.mjs measures the latest part. Rule: PROTOCOL.md § Date discipline, § Log format. Remove this key to switch rollover off; nothing already written changes.
